name: Osseus
long_description:
In an era of cheap intelligence, the most important application of AI will be to improving human health, globally. Osseus provides off-the-shelf or custom medical and biological datasets and RL environments to frontier labs.

We work with hospitals and clinics to provide our EHR and deploy AI models within clinical workflows, with models from both our frontier lab partners and our own research.
one_liner: The frontier data platform for health and biological AI
